definitions.explanation: A hoofed mammal with antlers (in males). Deer are common in Japan and are famously tame in places like Nara.

examples.japanese: ⟦{奈良公園|ならこうえん}→奈良公園：noentry⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{鹿|しか}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦たくさん→たくさん：00597_takusan⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: There are many deer in Nara Park.

examples.japanese: {鹿|しか}⟦せんべい→煎餅：04958_senbei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}って→買う：00489_kau⟧{鹿|しか}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦あげた→あげる：00546_ageru⟧。
examples.english: I bought deer crackers and gave them to the deer.

notes:
{鹿|しか} refers to deer. Also pronounced {鹿|か} in some compounds.

Common expressions:
- {鹿|しか}⟦せんべい→煎餅：04958_senbei⟧ (deer crackers - sold in Nara for feeding deer)
- {鹿|しか}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{角|つの}→角：02158_tsuno⟧ (deer antler)
- ⟦{馬鹿|ばか}→馬鹿：03574_baka⟧ (fool - uses the kanji for horse and deer)
- {鹿|しか}⟦{肉|にく}→肉：02240_niku⟧ (venison)

Counter: ⟦{頭|とう}→頭：18067_tou⟧ or ⟦{匹|ひき}→匹：00939_hiki⟧

Cultural note:
The deer of ⟦{奈良|なら}→奈良：27451_nara⟧ are famous worldwide and considered sacred as messengers of the gods of ⟦{春日大社|かすがたいしゃ}→春日大社：noentry⟧. They roam freely in Nara Park and bow to visitors for crackers. Miyajima's Itsukushima Shrine also has free-roaming deer. In other areas, deer overpopulation causes agricultural damage.
